routes.description: People, teams, or systems that can perform the action.

agent.description: Parent domain agent for this action.

impact.description: Expected business impact in concise form.

spec.description: Natural-language action specification describing what should change, which records, and how success is measured. Not executable SQL.

name.description: Concise phrase summarizing the business issue.

issue.description: Short sentence describing the alert with key numbers.

subagent.description: Name of the monitoring subagent that found this alert.

actions.description: Recommended action specs for this alert. Specs are plans only; they are not executed.

name.description: Name of an alert already raised earlier in this populate run or already stored for the domain.

issue.description: Issue text of the prior alert.

subagent.description: Monitoring subagent that produced the prior alert.

subagent_name.description: Assigned name of this monitoring subagent.

instructions.description: What this specialized monitoring pass should look for.

previous_alerts.description: Alerts already found by earlier monitoring agents or already stored for this domain. Do not duplicate these.

alerts.description: New alerts with nested action specs. Exclude issues already covered by previous_alerts.

action_name.description: Name of the planned action being simulated.

spec.description: Natural-language action specification to convert into a simulated update.

allowed_data.description: JSON allow-list of tables and columns the simulation may touch.

summary.description: Human-readable simulation summary of estimated impact.

rows_affected.description: Estimated rows affected by the simulated update.

metrics_json.description: JSON string of before/after/delta metrics from simulate_impact.

action_name.description: Name of the approved action to execute.

spec.description: Natural-language action specification to convert into an executable update.

status.description: Must be approved. This agent never executes planned actions.

allowed_data.description: JSON allow-list of tables and columns the execution may touch.

executed.description: True only when execute_impact committed successfully.

metrics_json.description: JSON string of before/after/delta metrics from execute_impact.

MONITORING_OUTPUT_PROMPT: You receive previous_alerts: alerts already raised by earlier specialized monitoring agents in this run, plus any existing stored alerts for this domain.
Read previous_alerts carefully before creating new alerts.
Do not duplicate an issue that is already covered by previous_alerts, even if wording differs.
Be enthusiastic and proactive: hunt for multiple distinct issues in your specialty. Prefer raising several sharp alerts over returning none.
If evidence is borderline but CFO-relevant, raise an alert and state uncertainty in the issue text.
Only return the none alert when you truly cannot find any distinct specialty issue after tool investigation.
Your output is MonitoringOutput: a list of Alert objects.
Aim for 2-5 alerts when evidence supports it. Each alert must still be a distinct business issue.
Do not create one alert per raw row. Group similar rows into one issue, but do not over-collapse unrelated themes.
For every real alert, include one or more ActionSpec objects in actions.
ActionSpec fields: name, routes, agent, impact, spec.
spec must be a clear natural-language plan describing target records, intended change, and success metrics. Do not write executable SQL in spec.
Actions are plans only with status planned when persisted. Never imply an action was approved or executed.

Routes must be chosen from: ['ERP', 'Finance Agent', 'Treasury Agent', 'Collections Agent', 'Leakage Agent', 'Audit Log', 'Vendor Master', 'A/P', 'A/R', 'Controller', 'Treasury Manager', 'Commercial Lead', 'Procurement', 'Bank', 'Credit Manager', 'Collections']
impact should be concise (at most 10 words), using '{metric}: {before} {+/- change} -> {after}' when numerical.
Set subagent to your assigned subagent_name.
If there are no new distinct alerts, return exactly one Alert: name='none', issue='no alert detected', subagent=your name, actions=[].
SCHEMA_TOOLS_PROMPT: Before writing any free-form SQL or impact simulation SQL, call the domain describe_*_tables tool.
Use only column names returned by that tool. Never invent columns such as status when the real column is import_status.
For audit.import_batches, the status column is import_status.
You may pass an optional tables list to describe only the tables you need.
SIMULATION_TOOLS_PROMPT: First call the domain describe_*_tables tool and inspect real columns.

simulate_impact(table_name, where_clause, update_expression, metric_expressions, allowed_data) temporarily applies an UPDATE inside a transaction, measures metrics before/after, then rolls back. No permanent changes.
Convert the natural-language action spec into table_name, where_clause (no WHERE keyword), update_expression (no SET keyword), and metric_expressions.
metric_expressions must be bare aggregates like COUNT(*) or SUM(amount_idr_mn) without AS aliases.
Only reference tables/columns confirmed by describe_*_tables and present in allowed_data.
Use the most specific where_clause possible.
Treat results as estimated impact, not guaranteed outcomes.
SIMULATION_OUTPUT_PROMPT: Return SimulationOutput with summary, optional rows_affected, and optional metrics_json.
summary must explain estimated impact clearly for a CFO.
metrics_json must be a JSON object string when simulate_impact returned metrics.
EXECUTE_TOOLS_PROMPT: First call the domain describe_*_tables tool and inspect real columns.
execute_impact(table_name, where_clause, update_expression, metric_expressions, allowed_data) permanently applies an UPDATE and returns before/after metrics.
Convert the natural-language action spec into table_name, where_clause, update_expression, and metric_expressions.
Only reference tables/columns confirmed by describe_*_tables and present in allowed_data.
Call execute_impact only when input status is exactly 'approved'.
EXECUTE_OUTPUT_PROMPT: If status is not approved, set executed=false and explain that approval is required.
If executed, summarize committed impact and include rows_affected / metrics_json when available.
